name: a built-in type re-ranked at the server is refused, not merely locked in the builder
notes: The sharp case. DEEPEST_RANK is 4 BECAUSE the built-in sub-task's rank is 4, so accepting this definition releases every sub-task in the workspace from hierarchy.deepest-rank-parent-required while the type builder goes on displaying a lock the server does not hold. Before this check the event was accepted. workspaceId is deliberately omitted so completeEnvelope defaults it to ws_1 (ruling P5).

expected.reason: "Sub-task" is the built-in sub-task type; its rank is 4 and cannot be changed. Define a custom type for differently-ranked work.
